items.evidence: The LDC Committee aligned the weighting of the sales and operating profit goals to emphasize top line sales growth
Although the operating profit metric is used in more than one incentive, it is a key corporate goal
ROIC for each year in the performance period is defined as operating profit, net of tax
The pre-established definition of operating profit for each year in the performance period is the same
In March 2018, we granted performance-based restricted stock awards that were forfeitable if operating profit was less than 90% of the MIP target

equal_split.evidence: Each performance measure is separately determined and equally weighted.
